name: gamenight

scripts.build: node scripts/build-web.mjs && node scripts/build-engine.mjs tv-app/FamilyGameNight/GameNight/Engine/engine.js && node scripts/bundle-sets.mjs tv-app/FamilyGameNight/GameNight/Engine/sets.json
scripts.e2e: node scripts/e2e-phone.mjs && node scripts/e2e-tv.mjs && node scripts/e2e-spynight.mjs && node scripts/e2e-feud-host.mjs && node scripts/e2e-jeopardy-host.mjs
